children: Tech Mahindra Limited (NSE:TECHM) posted Q2 revenue Rs16,180.2cr and net profit Rs1,586cr, raised interim dividend and proposed 1:1 bonus as it pushes AI products (Indus Terra LLM, Zero Gravity Telco) while guiding modest CC growth, targeting 15% FY27 margins amid mixed analyst views.
Previous Week Recap
Tech Mahindra Q2 FY27 Revenue Beat, Dividend and Bonus
: TECHM Q2 FY27: revenue Rs16,180.2cr (+15.6% YoY, +3% QoQ), net profit Rs1,586cr (+32.7% YoY), EBIT margin 14.8% (+40bps QoQ). Interim dividend Rs15; 1:1 bonus proposed.
Interim Dividend Rs15, 1:1 Bonus
: Tech Mahindra announced an interim dividend of Rs15 per share and a 1:1 bonus share proposal, both subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals.
Qoq Revenue Growth Guidance, 15% Margin Target
: Tech Mahindra expects Q‑QoQ revenue growth of 1.2–1.7% in constant currency (alternate >1.6% CC, >1.5% USD), driven by retail, healthcare, Orange deal and telecom; FY27 margin target 15%.
Total Headcount, TTM Attrition, Diluted EPS
: Tech Mahindra Limited (TECHM) reported a total headcount of 152,206 employees, a trailing-12-month IT attrition rate of 11.7%, and diluted earnings per share of Rs 17.84.
AI-Focused Deals, AI-Linked Revenue Buckets
: Tech Mahindra CEO Mohit Joshi says most large deals now include AI. Company will start reporting AI-linked revenue in defined buckets in H2 of the fiscal year.
Analysts React: Buy, Hold, Neutral
: Analysts reacted to Tech Mahindra Q2: HSBC kept Buy with Rs 1,800 target, CLSA Hold at Rs 1,494, Nomura Neutral at Rs 1,650, noting mixed views on growth and margins.
EPS Upgrade, Target Price Raised
: Analyst raised TECHM EPS to INR 89 for FY28–FY29, kept target multiple 18x and revised target price to INR 1,590; TECHM trades near 19.5x FY28E EPS, premium to peers.
AI Initiatives: Zero Gravity Telco, SpaceXAI, LLM, Workshops

: Tech Mahindra rolled out AI initiatives: Zero Gravity Telco for AI-native telecom ops, SpaceXAI software engineering tie-up, Indus Terra 30B-parameter LLM, and expanded Google Cloud/Gemini workshops.
Indus Terra LLM, AI Partnerships Expanded
: TECHM unveiled Indus Terra, a 30B-parameter educational LLM built with Nvidia and AWS, and announced AI partnerships with Google, SAP, ServiceNow, Cisco and others to scale deployments.
Forex Headwind: ~$25m Potential Loss
: Kotak says Tech Mahindra may face a ~$25m forex loss this quarter from rupee weakness and hedging, which could weigh on net profit despite revenue growth.
